input_manifest.renormalization_scheme: MS-bar for light/heavy quarks; top is pole mass (see notes)
input_manifest.scale_convention: MIXED — not at a common scale; see notes
input_manifest.confidence_convention: All PDG mass uncertainties in the source file are 90% CL. Monte Carlo uses 1-sigma-equivalent Gaussian values: sigma_1s = sigma_90CL / 1.645.
input_manifest.correlation_assumptions: None — masses treated as independent. This is an approximation; PDG does not publish a full quark-mass covariance matrix.
input_manifest.top_mass_definition: PDG 2024 direct-measurement average (172.57 +/- 0.29 GeV). The summary table also lists a pole-from-cross-section value (172.4 +/- 0.7 GeV); a sensitivity check for that definition is included.
input_manifest.scale_notes: Light quarks (u,d,s): MS-bar at 2 GeV. Charm: MS-bar at m_c scale (~1.27 GeV). Bottom: MS-bar at m_b scale (~4.18 GeV). Top: pole mass from direct measurements. These are NOT at a common scale. Zenczykowski frames the phase discussion at 'low energy'. A scale-consistent test requires QCD running to a common scale. Results are CONDITIONAL on the mixed-scale assumption.

Q1_units.check: sqrt(m_j) = sqrt(M) * (1 + sqrt(2)*k*cos(...)) — sqrt(mass) = sqrt(mass) * dimensionless
Q1_units.notes: Dimensionally consistent. M in MeV, k and delta dimensionless.

Q2_inputs.check: All inputs from PDG 2024 with declared scheme, scale, and confidence convention.
Q2_inputs.notes: Mixed-scale inputs explicitly declared in INPUT_MANIFEST. Light quarks: MS-bar at 2 GeV, 90% CL converted to 1-sigma. Heavy quarks: MS-bar at own scale or pole mass, 1-sigma. No calibration or target selection reused. WARNING: mixed scales mean results are CONDITIONAL, not scale-consistent.

Q3_observable.observable: Best-fit phase delta_f for each sector (f=up, down) under Eq. (4)
Q3_observable.decision_threshold: No sigma-based falsification claim due to mixed-scale inputs. Report compatibility/tension qualitatively and with chi^2/p-values for fixed-phase fits. Do not claim 'falsification at N sigma'.
Q3_observable.notes: Following Codex D1 v3 audit: 'Treat any hierarchy tension as conditional unless the scale-consistent analysis justifies a stronger statement.' This run uses mixed-scale inputs, so all results are CONDITIONAL.

preflight.overall_notes: EXPLORATORY: may run sensitivity/diagnostic work but cannot produce prediction, sigma, or public language per Codex formula-readiness gate. Results are conditional on mixed-scale assumption.

regression_test_delta_u_2_27.notes: Free fit gives delta_U = 0.074517 rad. Zenczykowski predicts 0.074074 rad. Difference: 0.000443 rad (0.60%). Fixed-delta chi^2 = 16.6399 (p = 0.0000). Tension at 95% CL.

top_mass_sensitivity.notes: Using the cross-section top definition instead of the direct-measurement average shifts the up-sector phase. This is a definition systematic, not a fit error.

claim_boundary: No falsification claim. No sigma-based statistical claim. Results conditional on mixed-scale inputs. Scale-consistent test requires QCD running to a common scale.
